topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I can't believe I had to find this here, of all places. That ring, it's supposed to stay with family, handed down like a thread through generations. Not to be carelessly sold off. It was always hers, always meant to be. Now, it's just sitting here, under cheap lights, waiting for anyone to snatch it up. It shouldn't be like this. I don’t want to think about whose hands were on it, or how long it’s been here. I’m taking it back, no matter what. It belongs with us, not here, not like this.
